title: Calibrated for Which Policy? Conformal Uncertainty for Fixed World Models Under Intervention
abstract: arXiv:2610.35877v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Changing a deployment policy can invalidate a world model's uncertainty while leaving the physical transition mechanism and predictor unchanged. For one-step prediction, if source and target laws share the conditional mechanism $P(Y|X)=Q(Y|X)$, then the intervention is identified by the pre-outcome change of measure $w(X)=dQ_X/dP_X$. For policy-controlled dynamics this ratio factors into state-occupancy and action-propensity terms. Weighted conformal calibration transports marginal coverage to the target law; with an estimated ratio $\hat w$, $P_Q\{Y \in C_{\hat w}(X)\} \ge 1-\alpha-TV(Q,\hat Q) \ge 1-\alpha-E_P|w-\hat w|$. Population log-loss regret for a source-versus-target domain classifier bounds the same ratio error. If $h$ is its clipped target posterior, $\rho$ is the target-domain prior, and $\Delta(h)$ is population log-loss regret, then $E_P|w-\hat w_h| \le (1/(\rho\gamma))\sqrt{\Delta(h)/2}$. An exact cancellation improves

translated_title: 为哪个策略校准？干预情形下固定世界模型的保形不确定性
translated_abstract: 改变部署策略可能会使世界模型的不确定性估计失效，而物理转移机制和预测器本身保持不变。对于一步预测，如果源分布与目标分布共享条件机制 P(Y|X)=Q(Y|X)，那么干预可以通过结果前的测度变化 w(X)=dQ_X/dP_X 来识别。对于由策略控制的动力学，该密度比可分解为状态占据项与动作倾向项。加权保形校准可以将边际覆盖率迁移到目标分布；使用估计的比率 ŵ 时，有 P_Q{Y ∈ C_ŵ(X)} ≥ 1-α-TV(Q,Q̂) ≥ 1-α-E_P|w-ŵ|。源域与目标域二分类器的总体对数损失遗憾可以对同一比率误差进行约束。若 h 是其截断后的目标后验，ρ 是目标域先验，Δ(h) 是总体对数损失遗憾，则有 E_P|w-ŵ_h| ≤ (1/(ργ))√(Δ(h)/2)。一种精确的抵消改进了……
tldr: 该论文提出了一种加权保形校准框架：当部署策略发生干预变化时，通过分解为状态占据与动作倾向项的密度比，将固定世界模型的边际覆盖率保证迁移到目标策略，并利用源-目标域分类器的对数损失遗憾给出密度比估计误差的显式上界。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes a weighted conformal calibration framework that transports a fixed world model's marginal coverage guarantees across policy interventions via a density ratio factored into state-occupancy and action-propensity terms, with the ratio-estimation error explicitly bounded by the log-loss regret of a source-versus-target domain classifier.
